scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter frontend test:pages && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @socket-help/tools build && pnpm --filter @socket-help/sdk build && pnpm --filter @socket-help/cli build
scripts.release:version: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts && pnpm test:packages
